messages:
eli_sales: 👋 Heads-up — ZephyrBank (mid-market fintech) is asking for a short POC next week. Main asks: SSO (SAML w/ Okta + Azure AD), SCIM for user + group sync (bulk import ~10k users), RBAC with delegated admins, domain proofing for multiple brands, and 13+ months of audit log retention. They also want a clear pricing path for Dedicated vs hosted for a 6–12 month prod rollout. Can we confirm feasibility and what we need for presales?
maria_se: Thanks. Quick q: expected concurrent users / auths per minute during the POC and target steady-state after rollout? SCIM load shapes decide whether we recommend batch delta vs realtime. Also do they require on-prem/private deployment or will VPC be acceptable?
eli_sales: Rough numbers from the customer: 10k directory users, peak 200 logins/min during onboarding, steady ~10–20/min. They said "regulated" but open to VPC; legal will decide after security questionnaire. POC window = 3 weeks.
sam_security: Key security checks we should flag now: KMS-backed encryption at rest (bring-your-own-key option), SOC2 Type II, yearly pen tests, audit log immutability + export APIs, and SAML signed assertions with SHA-256. I'll drop the security questionnaire we need them to fill out. Link: https://redwood.internal/sq/zephyrbank (internal) :page_facing_up:
devon_re: Technical notes for the POC: we support SAML metadata uploads and an entityID/ACS mapping. For SCIM we can do delta paging; sample SCIM config snippet for bulk imports:```json
{
  "sync_mode": "bulk-delta",
  "page_size": 200,
  "concurrency": 4,
  "retry_policy": {"backoff": "exponential", "max_retries": 5}
}
```
RBAC: we support custom role templates + delegated admin groups (limit: 50 custom roles org-wide). If they need >50 we need an engineering review.
alice_sales_engineer: For pricing, two paths: 1) Hosted usage-based (we can cap spend via quotas for POC) or 2) Dedicated reserve (monthly commit) — for their scale we should model both. Suggest we offer a 3-week free POC credit + a scoped Dedicated dev slot for integration testing. I'll prepare a ballpark — need final expected token/embedding volumes to size.
eli_sales: I'll ask Zephyr for token/embedding estimate. Also they asked about domain proofing process across 3 brands — confirm we support DNS TXT for claim + email support fallback. Which is faster?
maria_se: DNS TXT easiest for them if they have DNS control. Email fallback slower (manual). For enterprise we typically recommend DNS for automation. I'll prepare a runbook that includes DNS TXT TTL guidance and example TXT name/value.
eli_sales: Can someone spin up a dev Dedicated slot temporarily for the POC? Need it provisioned by Monday EOD.
oncall_bot: Reserved dev-dedicated-1 (g4dn.xlarge equiv) for zephyr-poc until 2024-06-07T23:59:00Z — ticket #INC-5521. :white_check_mark:
maria_se: I'll compile the presales checklist and drop the SAML attribute mapping template (email, displayName, groups) + SCIM rate limits doc. tagging @eli_sales :thumbsup:
